steps.en: Create a bot and scan the QR code with your phone
steps.zh: 创建机器人，用手机扫码登录

steps.en: Logs in through its pinned ItChat and turns friends, groups and official accounts into objects
steps.zh: 通过钉死版本的 ItChat 登录，把好友、群、公众号变成对象

steps.en: Register a reply function for a chat, a friend, or a message type
steps.zh: 给某个聊天、好友或消息类型注册回复函数

steps.en: Routes each new message to the last-registered matching function, on worker threads
steps.zh: 把每条新消息交给最后注册的匹配函数，用多线程处理

steps.en: Sends the function's return value back into that chat
steps.zh: 把函数的返回值发回那个聊天

value.en: Personal-account automation in object-style Python instead of raw ItChat dicts — while the web login worked
value.zh: 用对象式 Python 写个人号自动化，不用摆弄 ItChat 的原始字典——前提是网页登录还能用

sources: README.rst @ master (archived; last commit 2017-07-29): 轻松安装 ('wxpy 支持 Python 3.4-3.6，以及 2.7 版本'; pip install -U wxpy); 简单上手 (bot = Bot() 扫码登陆; @bot.register(my_friend) with return value as reply; '优先匹配后注册的函数'; bot.join()); 模块特色 ('全面对象化接口', '默认多线程响应消息', '可混合使用 itchat 的原接口')
